spec.title: Requests
spec.description: A request no router matched never reaches a backend, and is counted by `Unrouted requests` instead.

spec.expr: sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Failed requests by status class
spec.description:
Failed requests by status class.
- `none`: Traefik's code 0, no status ever sent, because the client disconnected or the backend could not be reached.
- A 404 a router matched counts here; one no router matched never reached a service and is in `Unrouted requests`.

spec.expr:
sum by (class) (
  label_replace(
    label_replace(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"0|[45].."}[$__rate_interval]),
      "class", "${1}xx", "code", "([45])[0-9][0-9]"),
    "class", "none", "class", "")
)

spec.title: Slow request share
spec.description: The histogram resolves 100 ms, 300 ms, 1.2 s and 5 s, and nothing between. HTTP only.

spec.expr:
1 - sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="0.3"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__rate_interval]))

1 - sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="1.2"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__rate_interval]))

1 - sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="5.0"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description: `In` is what clients sent, `Out` what Traefik answered. Only requests a router matched are counted — an unrouted request moves no bytes here.

spec.expr: sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(traefik_service_responses_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (code) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__interval])) > 0

spec.title: Mean request duration
spec.description: HTTP only. Dashed lines mark Apdex's boundaries, 300 ms and 1.2 s.

spec.expr:
sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / sum(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description:
- `Mean` and `Slow` cover HTTP only, and are blank for a service that served none.
- `Mean` colours at Apdex's own boundaries, 300 ms and 1.2 s, and again at 5 s where the histogram stops resolving.
- `Slow` is the share over 1.2 s, coloured at 6 % and 15 % — the shares at which Apdex can no longer reach excellent or good — and red at 30 %.

spec.expr:
label_replace(sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

round(
  label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"4.."}[$__range])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")
  or label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0,
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")
)

round(
  label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__range])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")
  or label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0,
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")
)

label_replace(
  sum by (service)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range]))
  / (sum by (service)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])) > 0),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

label_replace(
  1 - sum by (service)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="1.2"}[$__range]))
  / (sum by (service)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])) > 0),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_responses_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

label_replace(sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

spec.title: Requests by service
spec.description: The five services with the most traffic over the visible range; `other` is every remaining service summed.

spec.expr:
label_replace(sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
and topk(5, sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range]))),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")

sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
- sum(sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
and topk(5, sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range]))))

spec.title: Error ratio
spec.description: 5xx responses as a share of all requests.

spec.expr:
sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__range]))
  / sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range]))

spec.description:
`Connections` is the current value, not reduced over the range.

- `Up` is the share of scrapes that reached Traefik, red below 99.5 %.
- `Mean` and `Slow` cover HTTP only.
- `Mean` colours at Apdex's own boundaries, 300 ms and 1.2 s, and again at 5 s where the histogram stops resolving.
- `Slow` is the share over 1.2 s, coloured at 6 % and 15 % — the shares at which Apdex can no longer reach excellent or good — and red at 30 %.

spec.expr: avg by (host) (avg_over_time(up{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))
sum by (host) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range]))

round(
  sum by (host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__range]))
  or sum by (host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0
)

sum by (host)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range]))
  / (sum by (host)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])) > 0)

1 - sum by (host)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="1.2"}[$__range]))
  / (sum by (host)(rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])) > 0)
sum by (host) (traefik_open_connections{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", entrypoint!="traefik"})
sum by (host) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range]))
sum by (host) (increase(traefik_service_responses_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range]))

round(
  sum by (host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"4.."}[$__range]))
  or sum by (host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0
)

spec.description:
- `Mean` and `Slow` cover HTTP only, and are blank for a pair that served none.
- `Mean` colours at Apdex's own boundaries, 300 ms and 1.2 s, and again at 5 s where the histogram stops resolving.
- `Slow` is the share over 1.2 s, coloured at 6 % and 15 % — the shares at which Apdex can no longer reach excellent or good — and red at 30 %.

spec.expr:
sum by (key, service, host) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(sum by (service, host) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])),
      "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
    "key", " · ", "service", "host")
)

round(
  sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"4.."}[$__range])),
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  )
  or sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0,
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  )
)

round(
  sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__range])),
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  )
  or sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])) * 0,
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  )
)

sum by (key) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(sum by (service, host) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])),
      "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
    "key", " · ", "service", "host")
)
  / (sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])),
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  ) > 0)

1 - sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="1.2"}[$__range])),
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  )
  / (sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range])),
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  ) > 0)

sum by (key) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(sum by (service, host) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])),
      "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
    "key", " · ", "service", "host")
)

sum by (key) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])),
      "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
    "key", " · ", "service", "host")
)

sum by (key) (
  label_join(
    label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_responses_bytes_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])),
      "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
    "key", " · ", "service", "host")
)

round(
  sum by (key) (
    label_join(
      label_replace(sum by (service, host) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", code=~"5.."}[$__interval])),
        "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker"),
      "key", " · ", "service", "host")
  )
) > 0

spec.title: Apdex
spec.description: Share of HTTP requests answered within 300 ms, plus half of those answered between 300 ms and 1.2 s. Websocket sessions are excluded.

spec.expr:
(sum(increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="0.3"}[$__range]))
  + sum(increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http", le="1.2"}[$__range]))) / 2
  / sum(increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Open connections by host
spec.description: Peak per bucket, public entrypoints only; the service filter does not apply.

spec.expr: max_over_time(sum by (host) (traefik_open_connections{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", entrypoint!="traefik"})[$__interval:]) > 0
round(sum by (tls_version, tls_cipher) (increase(traefik_service_requests_tls_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Certificates
spec.description: `Instances` counts the Traefik processes serving the certificate.

spec.expr: min by (cn, sans, serial) (traefik_tls_certs_not_after{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}) * 1000
min by (serial) (traefik_tls_certs_not_after{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}) - time()
count by (serial) (traefik_tls_certs_not_after{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})

spec.title: Services reached over legacy TLS
spec.description: Handshakes below TLS 1.3, attributed to the service the request was routed to. A service here has at least one client that cannot negotiate 1.3.

spec.expr:
round(label_replace(
  sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_tls_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", service=~"$service", tls_version!="1.3"}[$__range])),
  "service", "$1", "service", "(.*)_service@docker")) > 0

spec.title: Open connections
spec.description: Public entrypoints only. A connection carries requests to any service, so the service filter does not apply.

spec.expr: sum(traefik_open_connections{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", entrypoint!="traefik"})

spec.description: Traefik's own log, warnings and errors only; access-log lines in the same stream are filtered out.

spec.expr:
sum by (detected_level) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} !~ `^\{`
| regexp `\x1b\[0m \x1b\[[0-9;]+m(?P<lvl>[A-Z]{3})\x1b\[0m `
| label_format detected_level=`{{ if eq .lvl "ERR" }}error{{ else if eq .lvl "WRN" }}warn{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`
[$__interval]))

spec.description: The newest 1000 lines matching the filters above.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} !~ `^\{`
| regexp `\x1b\[0m \x1b\[[0-9;]+m(?P<lvl>[A-Z]{3})\x1b\[0m `
| label_format detected_level=`{{ if eq .lvl "ERR" }}error{{ else if eq .lvl "WRN" }}warn{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`
| detected_level =~ `$errors_only`
| drop lvl, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport

spec.description: Every distinct line Traefik's own log wrote, colour codes stripped.

spec.expr:
sum by (detected_level, message) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} !~ `^\{`
  | regexp `\x1b\[0m \x1b\[[0-9;]+m(?P<lvl>[A-Z]{3})\x1b\[0m (?P<msg>.*)`
  | label_format detected_level=`{{ if eq .lvl "ERR" }}error{{ else if eq .lvl "WRN" }}warn{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`,
    message=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m" .msg "" }}`
| detected_level =~ `$errors_only`
[$__range]))

spec.title: Memory
spec.description:
`max` is the highest instance at each point, `mean` the average across instances.
- A different instance can hold `max` from one point to the next, so the line is not one instance's history.

spec.expr: max(process_resident_memory_bytes{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})
avg(process_resident_memory_bytes{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})

spec.title: CPU
spec.description:
CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.
- `max` is the highest instance at each point, `mean` the average across instances.
- A different instance can hold `max` from one point to the next, so the line is not one instance's history.

spec.expr: max(rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))
avg(rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description:
`max` is the highest instance at each point, `mean` the average across instances.
- A different instance can hold `max` from one point to the next, so the line is not one instance's history.

spec.expr: max(go_goroutines{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})
avg(go_goroutines{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})

spec.title: Config reloads
spec.description: Summed across the selected instances. With the Docker provider, Traefik rereads its dynamic configuration on every Docker event, so a steady rate means container churn, not a fault.

spec.expr: sum(increase(traefik_config_reloads_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Instances
spec.description: `Memory`, `Goroutines` and `Uptime` are current values; `CPU` and `Reloads` are reduced over the range.

spec.expr: sum by (host) (process_resident_memory_bytes{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})
sum by (host) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}[$__range]))
sum by (host) (go_goroutines{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})
max by (host) (time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"})

spec.description: Requests that reached a router and came back 400-599: red 5xx, orange 4xx. A request a middleware refused counts as `4xx`.

spec.expr:
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", svc="ServiceName"
  | status >= 500
  | svc =~ `$service`
[$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", svc="ServiceName"
  | status >= 400 | status < 500 | (svc != `` or status != 404)
  | svc =~ `$service`
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Requested hosts with no route
spec.description:
Requests no router matched, one row per requested `Host` header and the Traefik that answered it.
- `Top client` is the busiest of `Clients`, not the only one.
- A host that normally has a route appears here while its container is down: Traefik drops the router with the service, so a restart or any planned stop reads as a handful of 404s.
- The Service filter does not apply: an unrouted request has no service.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(sum by (key, vhost, hostname) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json svc="ServiceName", status="DownstreamStatus", vhost="RequestHost", client="ClientHost"
  | svc = `` | status = 404
  | label_format key=`{{ .vhost }} · {{ .hostname }}`
[$__range])))

count by (key) (sum by (key, client) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json svc="ServiceName", status="DownstreamStatus", vhost="RequestHost", client="ClientHost"
  | svc = `` | status = 404
  | label_format key=`{{ .vhost }} · {{ .hostname }}`
[$__range])))

topk by (key) (1, sum by (key, client) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json svc="ServiceName", status="DownstreamStatus", vhost="RequestHost", client="ClientHost"
  | svc = `` | status = 404
  | label_format key=`{{ .vhost }} · {{ .hostname }}`
[$__range])))

sum by (key) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json svc="ServiceName", status="DownstreamStatus", vhost="RequestHost", client="ClientHost"
  | svc = `` | status = 404
  | label_format key=`{{ .vhost }} · {{ .hostname }}`
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Clients by failed request
spec.description: Clients that got a 4xx or 5xx, by the service they asked for and the Traefik that answered. `5xx` counts the ones the backend failed; the rest are 4xx. Requests no router matched are not counted: they have no service.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(sum by (key, client, service, hostname, svcvar) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", client="ClientHost", service="ServiceName"
  | status >= 400
  | (service != `` or status != 404)
  | service =~ `$service`
  | label_format service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`, key=`{{ .client }} · {{ .service }} · {{ .hostname }}`
  | label_format svcvar=`{{ if .service }}{{ .service }}_service@docker{{ else }}$__all{{ end }}`
[$__range])))

sum by (key) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", client="ClientHost", service="ServiceName"
  | status >= 400
  | (service != `` or status != 404)
  | service =~ `$service`
  | label_format service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`, key=`{{ .client }} · {{ .service }} · {{ .hostname }}`
  | status >= 500
[$__range]))

spec.description:
The newest 1000 requests matching the `Status` filter above, newest first.
- `unrouted`: a 404 no router matched.
- A blank `Service` that is not `unrouted`: a middleware refused the request before it reached a backend. Selecting a service hides both.
- `Duration`: the whole exchange as the access log measured it.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
|= `$client`
| json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName", client="ClientHost", user="ClientUsername",
    path="RequestPath", method="RequestMethod", dur="Duration", vhost="RequestHost"
| status >= 400
| service =~ `$service`
| label_format class=`{{ if and (eq .status "404") (eq .service "") }}unrouted{{ else }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^([45]).+$" .status "${1}xx" }}{{ end }}`
| class =~ `$status`
| label_format user=`{{ if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}`
| label_format service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`, url=`{{ .vhost }}{{ .path }}`
| drop class, path, vhost, detected_level, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport, __stream_shard__

spec.description:
URLs that answered 5xx, from the access log.
`Code` is the one answered most often on that URL; query strings are stripped.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName", path="RequestPath", vhost="RequestHost"
  | status >= 500
  | service =~ `$service`
  | label_format endpoint=`{{ .vhost }}{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}`, service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`
[$__range])))

topk by (endpoint) (1, sum by (endpoint, service) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName", path="RequestPath", vhost="RequestHost"
  | status >= 500
  | service =~ `$service`
  | label_format endpoint=`{{ .vhost }}{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}`, service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`
[$__range])))

topk by (endpoint) (1, sum by (endpoint, status) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName", path="RequestPath", vhost="RequestHost"
  | status >= 500
  | service =~ `$service`
  | label_format endpoint=`{{ .vhost }}{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}`, service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`
[$__range])))

spec.description:
The newest 1000 requests that took over a second and answered below 400, newest first.
- Sessions that never got a status — websockets, and clients that hung up — are excluded.
- `Duration` is the whole exchange as the access log measured it, to the nanosecond.
- A long-polling endpoint runs for a minute by design, and every one of its requests lands here.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
|= `$client`
| json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName", client="ClientHost", user="ClientUsername",
    path="RequestPath", method="RequestMethod", dur="Duration", vhost="RequestHost"
| status > 0 | status < 400
| service =~ `$service`
| label_format user=`{{ if .user }}{{ .user }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}`
| label_format service=`{{ regexReplaceAll "_service@docker$" .service "" }}`, url=`{{ .vhost }}{{ .path }}`
| drop path, vhost, detected_level, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport, __stream_shard__

spec.description: Requests Traefik answered 400-599, split by the `Status` filter above: red 5xx, orange 4xx, purple `unrouted`. The table below reaches back 1000 requests.

spec.expr:
sum by (class) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName"
  | status >= 400
  | service =~ `$service`
  | label_format class=`{{ if and (eq .status "404") (eq .service "") }}unrouted{{ else }}{{ regexReplaceAll "^([45]).+$" .status "${1}xx" }}{{ end }}`
  | class =~ `$status`
[$__interval]))

spec.description: Requests that took over a second and answered below 400. The table below reaches back 1000 requests.

spec.expr:
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json status="DownstreamStatus", service="ServiceName"
  | status > 0 | status < 400
  | service =~ `$service`
[$__interval]))

spec.description: 404s Traefik answered itself because no router matched the `Host` header asked for. The Service filter does not apply: an unrouted request has no service.

spec.expr:
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/traefik", hostname=~"$hostname"} |~ `^\{`
  |= `$client`
  | json svc="ServiceName", status="DownstreamStatus"
  | svc = `` | status = 404
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Certificate expiry
spec.description: Time left on the certificate that expires first across the selected hosts.

spec.expr: min(traefik_tls_certs_not_after{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname"}) - time()

spec.title: Unrouted requests
spec.description: 404s Traefik returned itself, because no router matched the request: entrypoint 404s minus the 404s a backend produced. The service filter does not apply — an unrouted request has no service.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum(increase(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", code="404"}[$__range]))
  - sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{job="prometheus.scrape.traefik", host=~"$hostname", code="404"}[$__range])), 0)

spec.name: service
spec.label: Service
spec.description: Does not apply where a request has no service: unrouted 404s, open connections, certificates, and Traefik's own runtime and log.

spec.name: client
spec.label: Client
spec.description: A substring of the raw access-log line, so a partial address also matches longer ones, and a value that occurs elsewhere in the line matches too. Log-derived panels only: the metrics carry no client. Set by clicking a client, or typed here.

spec.name: status
spec.label: Status
spec.description: Which failures the Failed Requests feed carries. `unrouted` is the 404 Traefik answers itself when no router matched, held out of `4xx` because one dead vhost can outnumber every other failure.

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only `ERR` lines, hiding the `WRN` advisories a restart repeats on every entrypoint.
